Plot Area Converter

sq ft ↔ sq yd ↔ bigha ↔ kanal ↔ acre
Rajasthan bigha = 2529 sq yd (pakka), kanal = 505.33 sq yd (kaccha alag). Registry document ka unit dekho.

DLC Rate (Circle) — Jaipur Collector

Rajasthan e-Panjiyan • Information Services → e-Value (Online DLC)
Jaipur • DLC
↗ Check online — e-Panjiyan epanjiyan.rajasthan.gov.in · District → Urban/Rural → SRO → Zone → Colony → Captcha → Show Result
Kaise check karein (6 steps)
  1. e-Panjiyan portal pe jao — epanjiyan.rajasthan.gov.in
  2. Information Services me ja ke “e-Value (Online DLC)” chun lo
  3. District: Jaipur select karo
  4. Urban ya Rural select karo
  5. Apna Sub-Registrar Office (SRO), phir zone aur colony/locality select karo
  6. Captcha bharo → Show Result — wahan residential / commercial / industrial / agricultural ke alag-alag rate aur kabhi exterior vs interior alag dikhenge

Registry duty max(market value, DLC value) pe lagti hai — deal se pehle latest DLC zaroor verify karo. Neeche BCS default rates sirf indicative hain.

DLC (Collector rate) — Jaipur me sab ise circle rate kehte hain; official name DLC hai. Result me residential/commercial/industrial/agri aur exterior/interior alag ho sakte hain. e-Value (Online DLC) se latest verify karo.
🗺️

State-wise Stamp Duty & Registration

Sab states — indicative rates, women concession ke saath
India · FY 2026-27
Rates state registration dept ke indicative hain — sub-city slab se alag ho sakte hain.
Duty MAX(agreement, circle) par lagti hai. Concessions: mahila, first-home, affordable schemes state-wise. Delhi slab-based (≤₹25L kam), MH city-wise, KA zonal — exact rate registration dept site se verify karein.
🧾

TDS on Purchase — Sec 194-IA (buyer pays)

₹50L+ purchase par 1% — Form 26QB, 30 din
Income-tax Act
Buyer khud TDS deposit karta hai — Form 26QB (7 din me) + Form 16B seller ko 15 din me. TDS sirf resident seller par 1%; NRI seller par Sec 195 (12.5%+ ya lower deduction certificate) — CA se plan karayein.
📊

Capital Gains on Sale

LTCG 12.5% / 20%+indexation · STCG slab
FY 2026-27
Holding ≤2 saal → STCG (slab rate, indexation nahi). >2 saal → option A: 12.5% flat without indexation, ya option B: 20% with indexation — dono compare karke kam tax chunein. Exemption: Sec 54 (residential house reinvest) / 54EC bonds ₹50L cap. CII latest Income-tax portal se.
🏗️

Construction Cost Estimator

Jaipur rates — basic se luxury tak
Jaipur · 2026
Turnkey civil + finishing (structure, plaster, flooring, electrical, plumbing, paint). Land, approval fees, bore/tank alag. Jaipur market me labour + material variation 10-15% — contractor BOQ se confirm karein. Plot me basemen/stilt alag rate hota hai.
🧠

Google · public research

Five tools, five field jobs.

Choose an area and a deal focus. Each card opens the right Google tool in a new tab and offers a ready-to-copy prompt or alert query — no login inside BCS, no scraping, and no client name sent anywhere.

BCS rule: Trends shows public interest, not a forecast. Earth, Alerts, My Maps and Lens can need a Google account. Use them for public leads, site checks and verification only — never upload client lists, private documents or masked-name records. The 30% Originating / 35% Executing / 35% BCS split stays unchanged.

Why they are linked, not installed inside BCS

BCS Desk is one static HTML file that runs on GitHub Pages and offline on iPad — it has no server, database or install runtime. Canvix (Next.js + Postgres) and Listmonk (Go + database + SMTP) need a real server; Firecrawl is a developer API; KillerPDF is a native Windows program; Adobe Express is a cloud design app. Embedding them would break the single-file, zero-dependency promise and slow every 4G load.

Free forever is about the software license, not the hosting bill. Canvix is MIT, Listmonk and Firecrawl are AGPL-3.0, KillerPDF is GPL-3.0 — all genuinely open source. Adobe Express has a free plan but is proprietary, not open source, and some templates, AI tools and Pro features are paid. Running your own server may have a hosting cost; each open-source card links the official self-hosting guide so you can decide. Firecrawl's hosted plan is paid beyond a small free tier, and its own rules require respecting each website's terms — BCS keeps using free public discovery links and paste-capture for property research.

Content Growth Studio and the BCS EZWrite board are the two tools that run entirely inside BCS. The Studio's scoring is a transparent rule-based expert check — not a live AI model and not a guarantee of reach. The whiteboard keeps every stroke, page, note, toolbox widget and PNG export in this browser only — its ruler, timer, stopwatch, scoreboard, spinner, calculator, unit converter, spotlight and laser all run offline. Neither uploads text, client names or desk records.

Nothing changes in your desk data. Leads, projects, developers, advisors and backups stay exactly where they are. The 30% Originating / 35% Executing / 35% BCS split, client-name masking and preview-before-share rules remain untouched.

BCS · quick guide

How to run a huddle

Pen / marker sketch the site layout or annotate an imported image/PDF. Import places a local image or PDF on this page — the file stays in this browser. Web stamps a clickable link card; double-click it to open inside BCS. Line / rectangle / ellipse mark roads, plots and zones. Text / note add a label, then double-click to edit. Move drags notes, labels and imported media. Toolbox adds working ruler, protractor, compass and set-square guides with “place on board” buttons, plus calculator, timer, stopwatch, scoreboard, random draw, spinner, floating notes, unit converter, spotlight and laser pointer. Backgrounds include grid, dots, ruled, graph, blueprint, paper, slate and plain. Undo / redo fix a stroke; Export PNG saves a clean copy.

Pages, marks and the scratch pad live in this browser only. Clearing browser data removes them — export a PNG before a device reset.

💬 WhatsApp inbox desk

Forwarded messages → parse → classify → reply. Sab kuch isi device par.
WhatsApp se aayi message / forwarded chat yahan paste karein. BCS har sender ko thread me group karta hai — naam, mobile, budget aur requirement apne aap detect hote hain. Har thread check karein, role chunein, phir Save ya Reply. Incoming messages auto nahi aate — official API + server ke bina ye possible nahi (details "Limits & privacy" tab me).
Ye link aapki website / Instagram bio / Google Business par lagayein. Visitor WhatsApp me aapko message karega → aapke phone me aa jayega → yahin Inbox tab me paste karke record banalein. Ye free click-to-chat hai; koi auto-reply nahi, koi lead-data upload nahi.
https://wa.me/?text=Hi

Lead aapke WhatsApp me aayega — us message ko Inbox tab me paste karein, BCS usse lead/client/developer/advisor me classify kar dega. QR code chahiye to WhatsApp Business app ke "Message link / QR" se bana sakte hain — isme koi external service nahi.

Sachchi limit — auto-incoming free me nahi: WhatsApp par aane wali har message BCS me khud aa jaye iske liye Meta Cloud API, business verification, approved templates aur ek 24×7 server chahiye. Meta per-delivered-message charge karta hai. BCS single-file static app hai — isme API token chhupana possible hi nahi (token public ho jayega). Isliye yahan "auto" nahi, balki 10-second ka paste + classify + reply flow hai. WhatsApp Web automation karne wale "free API" tools unauthorized hote hain aur number ban ho sakta hai — unse bachlein.
Kaam kaise chalta hai
  1. WhatsApp se message / forwarded chat copy karke Inbox tab me paste karein.
  2. BCS sender-wise thread banayega — naam, mobile, budget aur requirement detect hote hain. Sab edit kar sakte hain.
  3. Role chunein: Lead (new requirement), Client (active deal), Developer / Advisor (network contact).
  4. Save to BCS — Lead/Client direct record ban jate hain; Developer/Advisor ka existing form prefilled khul jata hai.
  5. Preview & reply — exact text pehle dikhta hai, phir wa.me khulta hai. Send thread me log ho jata hai.
Technical & privacy rules
  • Sirf wohi message paste karein jo aapko bheji gayi ho ya jinhe forward karne ki aapko permission ho.
  • Bina likhit permission ke client ka naam share hone wale text me masked rakhein. Yahan inbox aapke device par rehta hai — koi upload nahi.
  • Opt-out / delete request par thread delete karein (DPDP Act 2023).
  • Koi auto-broadcast / spam nahi — har reply aap khud preview karke bhejte hain.
  • Commission split hamesha 30% Originating · 35% Executing · 35% BCS — is desk se kuch nahi badalta.

Official API chahiye to alag se chhota backend bana hoga. Tab bhi ye desk useful rahega — token-free fallback aur manual QA ke liye.
